target: Issuer-transfer stress test conditional on an eligible financial table. Select the first three eligible independent families in the order below. Never select by method output. Retain all failures and disqualifications; report denominator and reporting periods. Source inspection may proceed concurrently in registered order; a prefetched lower-priority case never displaces an eligible earlier one.
eligibility: First genuine financial table in primary-document order (or a substantive HTML EX-13 where the 10-K expressly incorporates the annual report). Require at least one issuer-specific USD amount in a separate monetary cell, with a unique attribution to one of the specified storms in a row, column, caption, preceding governing paragraph or footnote. Tables of independent occurrences, losses, adjustments, event-specific premiums, outstanding reserves or restrictions qualify. Exclude layout prose/bullets, ownership unrelated to the issuer, industry totals, limits/capacity unconnected with actual event, undivided multi-storm buckets, ratios, counts, shares, non-USD and non-monetary facts. In the first eligible table choose the first eligible storm in the stated storm priority. Collect EVERY explicit, attributable monetary fact for the named storm, including comparable periods/revisions/gross/net/segment amounts and displayed negatives/zero. Preserve signs, scale and original resolution. Separately identify repeated renderings of the exact same fact and components vs totals.
family_exclusion: Review earlier source inventories and full supplemental 2022 candidate list, recognized parents, successors and common-control companies. The unused low-priority reserve list in the v9 protocol was not examined. Reject any family with an earlier examined filing. We do not treat a purchase of a portfolio of policies as a merger of two issuers, but will choose at most one of Slide and FedNat to avoid even an asset-transfer overlap.
